Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Alan Casual Wood Bookcase, 23", Navy and Gold
Colors: Washed Navy
Materials: wood
With its lovely washed navy finish and gold hardware, this vertical piece will add beauty to your room as well as a way to keep organized. Two self-close drawers offer roomy storage. Use alone or with the Teal Story entertainment center. 23"W x 18"D x 68"H Hardwood and fiberboard; metal pulls with gold finish Casual transitional style Features two felt-lined drawers and two shelves Assembly in 30-60 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
